summary: Approval nodes pause a workflow until approved, with an optional timeout after which it is denied; approvers are users who can execute the workflow, org admins or above, or users with the Approve permission; denied or timed out approvals follow the on fail or always path, approved follows on success.
questions: How do approval nodes work in workflows?
Who can approve a workflow approval node?
What happens when a workflow approval times out?
Can I set a timeout for an approval node?

answer_card.title: Workflow approval nodes
answer_card.answer_md:
- An **Approval** node pauses the workflow until someone approves or denies it. Timeout defaults to none; if set, the request is denied when it expires.
- **Approvers**: users who can execute the workflow job template, organization admins (or higher) for its organization, or users given the *Approve* permission on that workflow.
- **Approved** follows the *on success* path; **denied** or **timed out** is marked failed/timed out and follows *on fail* or *always*.
- POSTing to an already resolved approval returns an error and does nothing.
